questions.prompt: What can a jigsaw do that a hand saw cannot do easily?
questions.reason: Its thin blade turns to follow curves.

questions.prompt: On a scroll saw, where do your fingers go?
choices: To the side of the blade
questions.reason: Fingers stay to the side, never in the blade’s path.

questions.prompt: When do you lift a random-orbit sander off the wood?
questions.reason: Lifting it while spinning can gouge the wood or fly around.

questions.prompt: Why are oily finish rags dangerous?
choices: They can catch fire by themselves
questions.reason: Drying oil makes heat. A grown-up lays them flat outside or puts them in water.

questions.prompt: Which finish cleans up with soap and water?
questions.reason: Water-based finishes are the easiest for kids.

questions.prompt: Before cutting with the jigsaw, check that…
questions.reason: The blade pokes out below the board.
